direction_contract: h' = h_ko + P_w(h_clean - h_ko): start under a live KNOCKOUT, ADD BACK the installed component, expect installation to RISE. Reference arm is KO.
sign_policy: reported contrasts keep their NATURAL sign in both directions; nothing is multiplied by -1. Only the DECISIONS (gates, ranks, verdicts) are oriented. Under --direction necessity a candidate that drops installation therefore appears here as a NEGATIVE number.
specificity_test: ONE-SIDED sign-flip (candidate > control), Holm-corrected across the control family (P1-h)

control_recovery_distribution.rank_orientation: rank 1 = the MOST POSITIVE value, i.e. the largest recovery
